name: Dolphin Kitchen Utensils and Appliances Ltd

facts.business: Dolphin Kitchen Utensils and Appliances Limited (formerly Sai Swami Metals and Alloys Limited) operates in the household appliances segment, manufacturing kitchen utensils and appliances.

auditor.name: M/s. Kapil Kumar Agarwal & Associates, Chartered Accountants, Rajasthan

key_risks: Raw Material Price Volatility: Fluctuations in the prices and availability of key raw materials may impact the Company's manufacturing costs, margins and overall profitability.

Demand and Market Competition: The Company operates in a highly competitive market with the presence of organized brands, regional manufacturers and unorganized players, which may create pressure on pricing and market share.
Low-Cost Imports: Availability of competitively priced imported kitchenware products may affect the Company's ability to maintain pricing and margins in certain product categories.

Regulatory and Compliance Risks: Changes in applicable laws, regulations, statutory requirements and industry standards may increase compliance obligations and associated costs and may require timely adaptation of business processes.
Energy and Manufacturing Costs: Variations in energy costs, manufacturing expenses, logistics costs and other operating inputs may affect the Company's cost structure and operating margins.
Distribution Risk: Dependence on dealers, distributors and retail channels may impact the Company's ability to expand its market presence and ensure consistent product availability.
Brand and Reputation Risk: Any adverse customer experience, product-related complaint or negative market perception may affect the Company's brand image and future business prospects.
